verdict.rationale: Edge0 has its own non-interactive interfaces: an `edge0 serve` command that exposes an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint you can curl, a one-shot chat CLI with flags like --max-new, a macOS CLI/daemon, a scriptable model-fetch script and env-var-driven benchmark script, and a Python `AutoEngine` API. Together these clearly support headless, scripted automation. missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline documentation or examples (e.g., GitHub Actions, containers), guidance on running on CI hardware (the CUDA backend is only a reserved slot), and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
